title: File-analysis names of batch p1-G12-1 (document_metadata, file_type_sniff, apk_triage, archive_listing)

attributes.file_sniff: file-type identification (P270, own magic table): {kind, category, description, confidence, entropy, routes (analysers the file goes to), polyglot, details, claimed_extension}
attributes.document_metadata: document metadata facts: {format, author(s), last_modified_by, company, manager, application, producer, template, title, created, modified, revision, pages, xmp, ...}; personal fields are redacted in external exports unless --include-personal
attributes.document_author: author name(s) recorded in a document's metadata (personal data: never auto-checked by person/username modules, redacted in external exports)
attributes.document_last_modified_by: last-modified-by / last-saved-by account recorded in a document (personal data)
attributes.document_company: company / organisation text recorded in a document's metadata (self-declared, untrusted)
attributes.document_summary: one summary line per document: format | application | author | company | top severity and finding codes
attributes.document_external_targets: external relationships and links of a document: list {type, target_kind, target, auto_load}; never fetched or resolved by V3LUM
attributes.document_macros: macro facts of a document: {present, modules, autoexec, suspicious keywords, xlm_sheets, dde}; macros are never executed
attributes.pdf_structure: pdfid-style structure of a PDF: {header, keyword counts, obfuscated names, encrypted, object streams inflated, open_action, embedded files}
attributes.apk_manifest: Android manifest facts: {package, label, version_code, version_name, min_sdk, target_sdk, debuggable, allow_backup, cleartext, permissions, exported components}
attributes.android_package: Android application package name declared in the manifest
attributes.apk_signing: APK signing facts: {schemes (v1/v2/v3/v3.1), certificates (sha256, subject, issuer, validity), consistent, verified: false (signatures are not verified)}
attributes.apk_contents: APK contents facts: {native libraries, packer hints, code-like assets, dex bytes, strings scanned, SDK/analytics/CDN noise hosts by class, non-routable IPs}
attributes.archive_summary: archive or disk-image listing summary: {kind, counts (members, files, declared total, encrypted, unsafe names), anomalies, stealer_bundle, stop reason, nested containers}
attributes.archive_members: archive members (capped list): {name, size, compressed_size, encrypted, flags, hidden, sha256, kind}; stealer bundles keep masked names and sizes only

tags.masquerading: file masquerading: the real type differs from what the name shows (extension mismatch, double extension, right-to-left override; ATT&CK T1036)
tags.polyglot: file valid as two formats at once (e.g. PDF+ZIP, PE+ZIP): content filters and analysts may see different files
tags.remote_template: document loads an external template or relationship when opened (template injection, T1221); its targets are never fetched
tags.maldoc: malicious-document indicators (auto-exec macros, XLM, DDE, auto-run PDF actions, exploit objects): suspicious, not a malware verdict
tags.banker_profile: Android permission profile consistent with banking trojans (accessibility, overlay, SMS, device admin): heuristic, not a verdict
tags.motw_bypass: container that defeats Mark-of-the-Web (ISO/IMG/VHD holding executables or scripts, T1553.005)
tags.archive_bomb: decompression bomb or archive limit reached: the listing is partial and nothing past the limit was read
tags.unsafe_path: archive member with an unsafe path (absolute, '..', drive letter, link or device): never extracted

relations.remote_template: document -> URL/host/IP of an external relationship loaded on open (template injection, T1221): hostile, passive modules only, never fetched or resolved over HTTP, SMB or WebDAV by V3LUM
relations.external_hyperlink: document -> click-only external hyperlink target (passive modules only, never fetched)
relations.document_author: document -> author or last-modified-by name/account from its metadata (personal data: analyst selection only, never auto-checked)
relations.local_account: document -> local account name taken from a user-profile path (C:\Users\<name>, /home/<name>) in its metadata (personal data)
relations.macro_string: document -> URL found in its macro source (macros are never executed)
relations.pdf_link: PDF -> target of a URI action (never fetched)
relations.link_in_message: Outlook message file -> URL found in its body (never fetched)
relations.message_sender: Outlook message file -> sender name or account (personal data: analyst selection only)
relations.signing_certificate: app or file -> SHA-256 thumbprint of the certificate it is signed with (signature not verified)
